_doc: Look S (Studio) scene recipe distilled from the V19..V21 reference masters (references/24_studio_look_recipe.md). Read by scripts/tools/studio_recipe.py. `grid` start times are seconds on the 40.633 s reference timeline: cut times come from the V19 walkthrough, scene starts S02/S08/S09/S12C from the V21 walkthrough; entries flagged approx are the recipe author's choice, not measured. The planner scales the grid to any duration and snaps each boundary to the nearest word gap. `chapters` follow the 4-act jewel table of the analysis doc dviet_19videos_complete_forensics_and_roundtable.md (act 3 split in 3A / 3B); `jewel` is the accent on dark worlds, `ink_on_light` the jewel ink on #FAFAFA paper. Chapter starts 15.05 and 34.0 are the V19 cut/drop times (the doc says 15.2 and 34.2). v7.7.0 adds `hook_0_5s` (hook recipe v3), `pacing` (max-hold, visual change per 5 s, dead-hold target) and `camera_punch_caps`; see references/28_hook_first_5s_and_pacing.md. Every number there carries its basis: basis ĐO = measured, basis ƯỚC = estimate (SFX times cannot be separated from voice and music, so all SFX times are ƯỚC).

H.note: full-screen clean B-roll hook, squircle PiP presenter

A1.note: full-head rounded studio card, text beat

A2.note: squircle PiP, B-roll / product / UI beat

B.note: bottom-flush cutout on dark silk, depth and CTA beats

pacing._doc: Pacing law (references/28_hook_first_5s_and_pacing.md). law_hold_s is the doctrine (no hold longer than 2.0 s without a reset), max_hold_s the studio recipe cap (2.4 s, error above it). A reset = a cut, a zoom step, a flash or a new text event; resets closer than merge_s are one change. dead_gap_s is a plan-level proxy for a dead hold (a stretch with no reset longer than 1.0 s, basis ƯỚC): compare the 45 % target only with the measured motion share of the rendered video, not with this proxy.

motion._doc: v7.8.0 motion floor and text-voice limits (references/28 sections 2-3). Basis: v3 hook 2.2-3.4 s (frame diff 1.20, 50 % of frames < 1.0, [ĐO]) against 17 @__dviet B-roll-first hooks (masked-background mean 1.9-2.4, [ĐO]); thresholds are [ƯỚC] from one channel. A background reset is a cut, flash, glint, card landing or a zoom step >= bg_zoom_step_min; PiP pops and text are overlay resets and never count. A full-screen B-roll hold longer than bg_static_run_s[0] inside the hook window (bg_static_run_s[1] elsewhere, warn) needs a micro-move: a push >= min_push_rate_pct_s per second on average, a pan >= min_pan_pct_crop_s of the crop per second, or a glint sweep. Proof [ĐO, engineer]: a 4 %/s push gives frame diff 1.23, a 14.5 %/s push 2.09. first_text_lead_ms and keyword_lead_ms are how far the text onset may lead the voiced word (the first text -50..+250 ms, a keyword 100-250 ms comfort band, hard limit voice_lead_max_ms). source_flow_ok_px_frame: a source clip moving more than this needs no remedy (the v3 macro measured 0.05-0.06 px/frame).

photosensitivity._doc: v7.9.0 flash guard (v4 review A1 / V-FLASH: a 1-frame full-white flash lifted the frame mean luma 52 -> 248 at 3.40 s and two shutter washes followed 0.25 s apart [ĐO]). A flash may not lift the frame mean luma (0..255) above max_flash_luma, and no 1 s window holds more than max_flashes_per_s flashes (WCAG 2.3.1: a flash = a pair of opposing changes). The plan check (motion_gate.check_flash_plan, called by studio_recipe.check_hook) assumes plan_base_luma under a flash [ƯỚC from the v4 troughs 52-78]; the render check is motion_gate.check_flashes (CLI --flash). Flash `opacity` is 0..100 like the FilmCraft transition field.

camera_punch_caps._doc: Maximum punch-in per layer (fraction over 1.00). The B cutout cap is low because the 720p A-roll is already about 1.5x upscaled; full-screen B-roll can take 25 % on a native 720p clip. Basis ƯỚC (set by the recipe author from the V19..V21 and v2 comparison, not measured on the channel).

hook_0_5s._doc: Hook recipe v3 (Look S, 60 fps, 1 frame = 16.7 ms). Basis: 17 @__dviet hooks measured (voice at frame 0 in 15/17, first text median 200 ms, first transition median 3.4 s, audio dip mean about 17 dB over 100-250 ms). Structure of V21 kept: full-screen product B-roll plus PiP presenter. Cut, text and voice times are ĐO targets taken from the measured hooks; every SFX, riser and vacuum time is ƯỚC because voice and music mask them (single channel, 17 samples). SFX files live in the sfx trends folder, shifted so the peak lands on t_ms (at_ms = t_ms - peak_ms). Avoid Combo_03_Tech_AI_Pattern_Interrupt (too glitchy); Combo_01_Editorial_Slide_Hook_DViet.wav is the quieter reference.

hero_box.note: measured hero box 10-21 % of frame height on 17 hooks; recipe 12-18 %; when the product is the hook picture the hero goes in the stage above it (s=0.72, cap-top-anchored zoom), never over it

the next spoken clause, 150-200 ms before its first word; exits to hand over to the cards

soft warm band sweeping left to right over the glass only, weighted by source luminance; amount 0.32 and above flickers [ĐO]
anchored snap-punch with a 3-frame gold-white flash, ahead of the voiced word; the cap top stays fixed so the product grows downward
three raw-photo cards drop into the top stage and land, 20-80 ms ahead of the words 'phía dưới là'; they never overlap the product
riser ramp inside the +25 % B-roll cap
